segments.text: He is an elite chemistry teacher with good looks and excellent abilities. He has been scouted by various school and moved throughout the country.
Dressed in a sharp suit, with the face of an idol, makes him a subject of admiration from many female students.
However, his true nature is that of a pervert who has trained and corrupted many students and teachers into being his slaves.
Raised strictly by an elite bureaucratic father and mother of Chinese descent, his personality formed from them, and has taken pleasure in disciplining women and dominating them.
Reiji became a teacher in order to find and train girls with potential to become his ideal slaves.

He has been training girls in schools all over the country and is constantly searching for new slaves, he sells girls who don't meet his standards to powerful clients in exchange of large amounts of money.
容姿端麗にして、能力も優秀なエリート化学教師。
様々な学園からスカウトを受け、全国を転々と渡り歩いている。
ふだんは爽やかで物腰柔らかな好青年を装っており、その容姿も相まって、さながらアイドルのように祭り上げられ、女子学生から黄色い声を浴びている。
だがその裏では、何人もの女子学生や女教師を調教し、奴隷に堕としてきた性犯罪者。
エリート官僚の父親と、華族出身の母親によって必要以上に厳格に育てられた影響で性格が屈折しており、女性を凌辱して調教することに悦びを見出している。
教師をしているのは、素質を秘めた女性を見つけて調教し、自分に釣り合う理想的な奴隷を手に入れるため。
各地を転任して回っているので、全国の学園で女性を調教してきたが、そうして仕立てた奴隷は転任の際に関係を清算し、権力者など客に売却して事後処理を任せている。
現在やってくるスカウトも、実は主人公に裏の仕事を斡旋するブローカー。
普通のスカウトも来るには来るが、持ちかけられる条件が破格のため、ブローカーからの仕事を受けている。
堕とした奴隷を売却することには、内心面白くなく思っているが、目的を果たすためにはやむを得ないと割り切り、情を残さないようにしている。

A student who was recommended for the school after her performance in a piano competition was recognized.
She is the best piano player in the school, and has been given her own piano and studio in the school.
An innocent young lady who is quiet and polite.
As she has been learning piano from her teacher ever since she was a child, she is a naive and does not how to be suspciious.
Shion is a bit shy because she rarely contact other people, she blushes a lot, especially around the opposite sex.
She's not completely unaware of the opposite sex, and she has feelings for the teacher who taught her how to play.
She's fond of the main character, since his demeanor reminds her of her beloved teacher.

A female student enrolled in the entertainment department with dreams of becoming a dancer.
Her plans for after graduation is to go to the United States and start working earnestly.
She is inspired by Western culture and often says phrases in English.
Asami is cheerful and energetic, with an expressive face, and easily liked by people of all ages and gender. But when she is alone, she gets quite lonely.
Also, due to her carefree nature, she is rarely treated like a girl, and due to being absorbed with dance, she never worried about her femininity.

However, when she met the protagonist, she asked him for a dance which he mistook it for a ballroom one. He treated her like a lady, which made her develop feelings for him. She has never been in love before and is quite curious.
ダンサーを夢見る芸能科の女子学生。
卒業後は渡米し、本格的に活動することを考えている。
欧米文化に感化され気味で、感動詞を英語で言うことが多い。
明るく元気でノリがよく、喜怒哀楽がハッキリしており、性別や年齢を問わず人に好かれやすい。
反面、一人でいることに慣れておらず、かなりの寂しがり屋。
また、気安さが過ぎるために異性から女の子らしい扱いを受けることはほとんどなく、本人もダンスに夢中なため、「女性らしさ」という事を気にすることはなかった。

それまで恋をしてこなかったため、男性と付き合ったこともなく、処女。

A girl who looks like a 'Yamato Nadeshiko' enrolled in the school's archery club.
Her parents died when she was young and was taken in by her grandfather, who was a strict archery teacher.
She has a calm personality due to being strictly-disciplined and is a bit old-fashioned.
Tsubaki is a high-honor student in both academics and sports, and almost gave up school due to financial reasons. But with the school deciding to use her for publicity, she reiceved a scholarship.
Because she is a beautiful girl with a well-developed body, she has been molested and stalked ever since she was an adolescent, and has fought them off each time.
As a result, she became guarded, and became intimidating towards men.
On the other hand, her nature makes her immensely popular with girls, with some even developing feelings for her.
She is a serious girls who is not weighed down by misfortune, and works very hard.

幼い頃に両親を亡くしており、師範であった祖父に引き取られて育てられた。
厳しく躾けられてきたために落ち着きがあり分別がついている一方で、少々古風なところがある。

The only daughter of a corrupt politician, she was admitted into the school with a large amount of money.
Because she was spoiled, Saori doesn't like it when things don't go her way, and won't stop until she achieves her goals. On the other hand, she doesn't care about things that don't benefit her.
She is surrounded by several men whom she treats as servants.
While a member of the swimming club, she doesn't concentrate on the club activities and tends to skip. And even if she participates, she only takes sunbaths.
Naturally, she is an oppressive presence in the school, with people keeping their distance to avoid getting involved with her.
She first met the protagonist several times when she was a child. Her parents have taken her to several parties where they met him.
She plans to get the protagonist, a well known teacher, as her personal servant.
With the use of her servant and her father's secretary, she investigated the protagonist and discovered his past. She tried to blackmail him, but was blackmailed and raped in reverse.

因为是在相当任性的情况下长大的，所以什么事都必须按照自己的想法去做。
为了达到目的，花钱收购或不择手段。
另一方面，对无利于自己的事情，完全不感兴趣。
她总是带着几个男人，作为仆人。
虽然属于游泳部，但并不是投入社团活动，多是在休息，即使偶尔参加，也是在游泳池边享受日光浴，为所欲为。
当然，在学校里是轻浮的，为了不让任何人与之有任何关系而保持着距离。
被父母带去的聚会上见过主人公几次面，从小就认识。
因而，与主人公亲密接触，但真正的目标是，在教育界也要把知名教师的主人公作为仆役。
她使用仆人和父亲的秘书调查主人公的事情，后来知道了主人公的本性并发出威胁，但是在那里反而被侵犯了。
An elite inspector is summoned by the academy after sensing that something strange is happening in the school due to the protagonist's machinations.
Takako has a dignified and cool demeanor, but she is willing to bare her fangs to anyone she deems an enemy.
A headstrong woman that her judgement is always right, and always pushes for her opinion, even if they're her boss.
Because of this, she is unpopular with others and tends to work alone.
Because of the competitiveness of the male-dominated society, she tends to look down on men for being on top.
The protagonist see's her as an antagonist, but also a new prey candidate.
Takako is raped by the protagonist, a man she looks down on, which opens up her secret slutty nature and instills in her the pleasure of being dominated by a man.
